# Otway Tree Care

> Local arborist based in Colac, Victoria, working across Colac, Apollo Bay, Lorne and the Otway Ranges: tree removal, tree pruning, stump grinding, storm & emergency work, forestry mulching & land clearing, hedging, property maintenance, green waste removal and tree assessments & advice. Led by founder Tom Kleindienst, a qualified arborist with 12+ years of experience.

- Phone: 0448 762 058 (24/7 emergency phone line)
- Email: otwaytc@gmail.com
- Based in Colac VIC 3250; works on site across the service area below
- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 7am–5pm
- Free, fixed-price quotes
- $20 million public liability insurance for arboricultural work; WorkCover for staff

Service area:
- Colac & district: Colac, Elliminyt, Alvie, Beeac, Birregurra
- Great Ocean Road: Lorne, Wye River, Skenes Creek, Apollo Bay, Marengo
- Otway Ranges: Forrest, Barwon Downs, Gellibrand, Beech Forest, Lavers Hill
- Further out: Winchelsea, Camperdown

## Services

- [Tree removal](https://otwaytreecare.com/tree-removal): Dead, dangerous or unwanted trees taken down safely in sections and cleaned up. Free site assessment and fixed-price quote. Call 0448 762 058.
- [Tree pruning](https://otwaytreecare.com/tree-pruning): Deadwooding, crown reductions and clearance pruning from roofs, lines and solar panels, by a qualified arborist. Free site assessment and fixed-price quote.
- [Stump grinding](https://otwaytreecare.com/stump-grinding): Stumps ground out below ground level with a compact tracked grinder — for lawns, driveways, gardens and building sites. Free site assessment and fixed-price quote.
- [Storm & emergency work](https://otwaytreecare.com/emergency-tree-removal): Tree down on a house, car, fence or road? Call Otway Tree Care on 0448 762 058 — 24/7. What to do first, what we do on site, and how emergency work is handled.
- [Forestry mulching & land clearing](https://otwaytreecare.com/forestry-mulching): Overgrown blocks, tracks, fence lines and firebreaks mulched where they stand with a tracked forestry mulcher — no burn piles or green waste to cart away.
- [Hedging](https://otwaytreecare.com/hedging): Hedge trimming, big boundary hedges and cypress windbreaks, reduced or removed and cleaned up. Free site assessment and fixed-price quote.
- [Property maintenance](https://otwaytreecare.com/property-maintenance): Scheduled vegetation care for acreage, commercial sites and holiday homes: trees, hedges, fence lines, tracks and fire-season clean-ups. Fixed-price schedules.
- [Green waste removal](https://otwaytreecare.com/waste-removal): Branch piles, storm debris and clearing waste chipped on site, then left as mulch or taken away. Logs cut, stacked or removed. Fixed-price quotes.
- [Tree assessments & advice](https://otwaytreecare.com/tree-assessment): Not sure what your tree needs? A qualified arborist will look at it with you, explain what they see and talk through the options. Free, no obligation.

## Projects

- [Dead Eucalyptus Removal, Skenes Creek](https://otwaytreecare.com/projects/skenes-creek-dead-eucalyptus): A huge dead eucalypt stood on a hillside above homes, a driveway and the road. Climbing it wasn’t safe, so Tom worked from a hired spider lift instead.
- [Liquid Amber Removal Over a House, Forrest](https://otwaytreecare.com/projects/forrest-liquid-amber-removal): A towering liquid amber was blocking gutters, causing flooding and mould inside, and had already failed onto the house once. It came down with rigging over…
- [Carving a Habitat Hollow Instead of Removing a Limb](https://otwaytreecare.com/projects/habitat-hollow): A dead limb was due to come down for firewood. After a chat with a regular client who loves birdlife, we carved a nesting hollow into it instead.
- [Cypress Windbreak Removal for a Native Garden](https://otwaytreecare.com/projects/cypress-windbreak-native-garden): An overgrown cypress windbreak along a rural driveway was removed, chipped and ground out to make way for a native garden that’s easier to manage.
- [Stump Grinding and a New Parking Pad](https://otwaytreecare.com/projects/stump-grinding-rock-pad): The owner had been trying to burn this stump out for years and needed the space for parking. We ground it out and built up a gravel pad.
- [Urgent Stump Grinding for a Builder, Geelong](https://otwaytreecare.com/projects/geelong-builder-stump-grinding): A builder needed stumps gone from a narrow side yard before foundation drilling started on the Monday. Big machines couldn’t get in; our grinder could.
- [Eucalyptus Pruned Off Solar Lights, Apollo Bay](https://otwaytreecare.com/projects/apollo-bay-roundabout-pruning): A eucalyptus at the new roundabout on Pascoe and Moore Streets was shading the solar panels on the street lights. We pruned it clear.

## Advice

- [Do you need a permit to remove a tree in the Otways?](https://otwaytreecare.com/post/tree-permits-otways): When do you need a council permit to remove or prune a tree in the Otways? A plain-English guide, updated for the 24 September 2026 canopy tree changes.
- [5 Signs a Tree Needs a Closer Look](https://otwaytreecare.com/post/5-signs-tree-safety-assessment-otways): Dead branches, cracks, fungi at the base, a new lean, or heavy limbs over the house — what to look for, and when to get a qualified arborist to check.
